independent_unit_policy: Participants are the population unit. Videos are fixed released support points or category-stratified empirical support as stated; no unseen-video population claim is made.

rows.endpoint: Saved versus separately implemented b and q targets; structural q-at-least-absolute-b invariant
rows.uncertainty: None; this is a deterministic artifact check

rows.endpoint: Other-axis alignment gain and own-versus-donor warp advantage
rows.estimator_or_test: Mean gain, participant x video crossed bootstrap, participant sign-flip diagnostic, donor derangement
rows.multiplicity: Axis-specific and combined contrasts are exploratory; no familywise claim
rows.population_unit: Participant; videos crossed as released support points
rows.resampling_or_folds: 5,000 bootstrap draws; outer participant folds retained

rows.endpoint: Held-out signed residual or absolute-magnitude prediction gain
rows.multiplicity: Four budgets are reported as an exploratory response curve; no confirmatory threshold claim
rows.population_unit: Participant, with held-out videos inside participant-safe folds

rows.endpoint: Sum of squared deviations among five category mean gains
rows.multiplicity: Budget-specific p values Holm-adjusted across four budgets; combined all-budget diagnostic reported separately
rows.uncertainty: Monte Carlo p value from 10,000 permutations

rows.endpoint: Profile rank, q shift, path geometry, and shared-reference descriptive variance ratios
rows.estimator_or_test: Five estimands, four path objectives, parameter and reference-panel sensitivities
rows.multiplicity: Sensitivity inventory; no reliability cutoff or confirmatory family
rows.population_unit: Participants and released videos under the stated empirical support
rows.resampling_or_folds: Participant-cluster resampling with within-category video sampling and rebuilt references
rows.uncertainty: Original-identity-excluding full-pipeline bootstrap (1,000 draws); geometry bootstrap (1,000)

rows.endpoint: Participant-macro MAE gain versus video-mean and context-only comparators
rows.estimator_or_test: Nested grouped CV with fold-safe targets, features, scaling, selection, and disabled-residual option
rows.multiplicity: Model inventory is descriptive; the blockwise residual stack is the declared primary sensor route; no equivalence margin
rows.resampling_or_folds: 5 outer x 4 inner folds; 5 complete participant partitions
rows.uncertainty: Participant percentile bootstrap (5,000 draws) plus complete split sensitivity

rows.endpoint: Reference-trace MAE gain versus video-only correction
rows.multiplicity: Four budgets form an exploratory burden-response curve; no smallest meaningful gain or utility test
rows.resampling_or_folds: 100 calibration subsets per budget; participant-safe folds

rows.endpoint: Counts of participants exceeding hypothetical benefit or degradation thresholds
rows.estimator_or_test: Exact integer count over a fixed 41-point grid
rows.multiplicity: Post hoc descriptive sensitivity only; thresholds do not define a decision rule
rows.resampling_or_folds: Uses participant estimates from the registered sensing/calibration pipelines
rows.uncertainty: No interval; conditional Wilson bands deliberately removed

rows.endpoint: Trial-macro valence/arousal MAE on the 1--255 scale and gain versus the metadata temporal prior
rows.estimator_or_test: Frozen visual representation, same-category trajectory retrieval, monotone content alignment, and inner-selected exact fallback
rows.multiplicity: Seven reported backbone/fusion candidates are a development inventory; no confirmatory winner claim
rows.population_unit: Participant, with videos treated as fixed released support points and held out jointly in outer cells
rows.resampling_or_folds: 5 participant x 5 video outer cells; 2 participant x 3 video inner folds; 5 participant-fold allocations
rows.uncertainty: Five complete grouped-CV participant allocations plus a fixed -3 to +3 s alignment sensitivity range

rows.endpoint: Trial-macro MAE gain over the frozen CLIP+SigLIP content prediction
rows.estimator_or_test: Causal current/past EEG-fNIRS ridge residual with inner gain gate and exact zero-residual fallback
rows.multiplicity: Full-feature and temporal-token routes are reported as gated development comparisons
rows.population_unit: Participant, with released videos held out jointly inside the fixed 15-video support
rows.resampling_or_folds: Same 5 participant x 5 video outer cells as the content prior; 2 participant x 2 video inner folds
rows.status: PRIMARY GATE FAILED; EXACT CONTENT FALLBACK
rows.uncertainty: Frozen five-point inner-gain decision curve; no equivalence interval or user-utility claim

rows.endpoint: Trial-macro MAE and gain over the canonical known-video population prior after one post-trial SAM pair
rows.estimator_or_test: Gaussian-weighted same-video trajectory retrieval plus bounded center/shape correction and functional residual ensemble
rows.multiplicity: Candidate inventory and ensemble were developed on this dataset; independent confirmation is required
rows.population_unit: Participant; videos crossed as the fixed released support in uncertainty propagation
rows.resampling_or_folds: 5 outer participant folds x 4 inner folds; 5 complete allocations
rows.status: POST-TRIAL SPARSE-FEEDBACK ROUTE; NOT ZERO INTERACTION
rows.uncertainty: Participant-video crossed percentile bootstrap (5,000 draws) and complete participant-fold allocation sensitivity

scope: Complete registry for quantitative claims retained in the main manuscript and Supplementary Information.
